path.description: The path at which to create the files, relative to the current workspace.

baseApiPath.description: Path for base API file. For Angular: defaults to path + '/_api-base.service.ts'. For RTK: defaults to 'th-common/store/api-base.ts'.

baseApiTemplatePath.description: Custom template path for base API generation.

framework.description: Target framework for generated API code: 'angular' or 'react-rtk'.

scopeEndpointsWithTags.description: Whether to scope endpoint names with tags for RTK Query. When true, generates names like 'postsGetAll' instead of 'getAll'. Recommended for APIs with multiple controllers to avoid naming collisions.

typeMapping.description: Map custom backend types to TypeScript primitives. Keys are schema names, values are TypeScript types (e.g., { 'SuperDuperInt32': 'number', 'CustomGuid': 'string' }).

templateHelpersPath.description: Path to a JavaScript file exporting custom helper functions for use in templates. The exported functions and values will be available in the template context.
